_comment: Manual matches for villages where the auto-matcher couldn't confidently resolve. Each entry: village_code → either a target LGD vil_lgd, or an explicit lat/lon. Status reflects confidence.

od-koraput-bhatabir.note: Bhatabir not in LGD as a distinct revenue village; using Nandapur block centroid as proxy.

cg-kanker-rodepara.note: Rodepara is a hamlet under Kanharpuri GP; using Kanharpuri village centroid.

jh-gumla-podha.note: Podha vs PORHA — same village, different transliteration. Block matches exactly.

jh-godda-talbadiya.note: Talbadiya vs TALBARIA — same village, different transliteration. Block matches exactly.
